title: Should You Start This Club?
description: Walk the four feasibility gates between an encouraging survey result and a real first meeting date.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Gauging Interest and Holding Your First Meeting

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given survey results and a candidate venue and team, the learner follows the correct sequence of feasibility checks to decide whether to establish a new club.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Hover-to-preview and click-to-pin decision flowchart with three gates and their remediation branches
pedagogical.assessment: Give a founder who has a survey, a venue and a co-founder but no cleared mentor, and ask what happens next.
